title: shoe storage with locking handles
text: shoe storage with locking handles. I bought these after buying some others at home depot that did not have the lock handles.  They were awful because the lids would not stay closed. These are perfect.  My shoes are women's 8 to 8 1/2 - all of my shoes fit - slip on sketchers, heels, sandals and even ankle boots.  The very best part of these are the lock down handles. They stack nicely when closed and the handles keep the lids securely on.  The are also a more sturdy plastic than the cheaper ones I purchased without locking handles.  Get what you pay for most of the time.  I would say these were well worth the price.  However, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  I would definitely buy these again and would feel comfortable recommending them.

description: Keep yourself organized with the contemporary styling of a 18-pack of ClearView Latch Box Storage Containers from Sterilite. These 32-quart ClearView Latch Boxes are ideal for storing linens, towels, clothing and more. With a convenient under-the-bed fit, these containers are ideal to keep items out of sight but close at hand. The clear base and lid allow contents to be easily identified from any angle. Color accented latches secure the lid to the base, yet are still easy to unlatch. The indexed lids allow same-size storage boxes to stack neatly on top of each other to use vertical storage space efficiently. The 32-quart and 66-quart (not included) ClearView Latch Boxes use the same lid, allowing both the shallow and deep sizes to be stacked in the same footprint. Take control of your storage and bring yourself the kind of peace that comes from a tidy and well-organized space with this 18-pack of 32-quart Clear View Stackable Storage Containers by Sterilite.
